content_en.prompt: Here are five statements describing three robots (Teena, Meena, Leena): 1. Teena and Meena are smiling. 2. Teena, Meena and Leena each have two legs. 3. Meena has a round head and Leena has two legs. 4. All three robots have five fingers. 5. Leena or Teena have their hands raised.
content_en.question: Which of these five statements are true?
content_en.explanation: Evaluate all statements and decide true/false, taking into account the meaning of AND and OR. "Teena and Meena are smiling" is true since both are smiling — this statement does not depend on Leena at all. "Leena or Teena have their hands raised" is also true.
content_en.ct_explanation: In computer science, the Boolean data type has two values (true/false), representing the truth values of logic and Boolean algebra. Many decisions in a program are based on boolean operators AND and OR. Being able to focus on the important information of a problem (ignoring irrelevant details) is a key computational thinking concept called abstraction.

content_zh.prompt: 以下是描述三個機器人（Teena、Meena、Leena）的五句敘述：1. Teena和Meena在微笑。2. Teena、Meena和Leena都各有兩隻腳。3. Meena有一個圓形的頭，而且Leena有兩隻腳。4. 三個機器人都有五根手指。5. Leena或Teena舉起了手。
content_zh.question: 以下這五句敘述裡，哪幾句是真的？
content_zh.explanation: 要判斷每句敘述的真假，必須先弄清楚「且」和「或」的意思。「Teena和Meena在微笑」是真的，因為兩個確實都在微笑——而且這句話完全不涉及Leena。「Leena或Teena舉起了手」也是真的，因為「或」只要有一個成立就算真。
content_zh.ct_skills: 演算法思維（Algorithmic Thinking）、抽象化（Abstraction）、評估（Evaluation）
content_zh.ct_explanation: 在資訊科學裡，布林（Boolean）資料型別只有兩個值（真/假），用來表示邏輯與布林代數中的真值。程式裡許多判斷都是靠「且(AND)」跟「或(OR)」這兩種布林運算子做出來的。能夠專注在問題中真正重要的資訊、忽略不相關的細節，是運算思維裡一個很重要的概念，叫做「抽象化」。
